## Best.list

```{r}
library(atime)
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(directlabels)
library(dplyr)
```

#showing the best fit asymptotic time complexity for each linear and constant timings

```{r}
(subject.size.vec <- unique(as.integer(10^seq(0,2,l=10))))

atime.list <- atime::atime(
  N=subject.size.vec,
  setup={
    subject <- paste(rep("a", N), collapse="")
    pattern <- paste(rep(c("a?", "a"), each=N), collapse="")
  },
  times=10,
  seconds.limit=0.1,
  PCRE = regexpr(pattern, subject, perl=TRUE),
  TRE = regexpr(pattern, subject, perl=FALSE)
  )
```

```{r}
atime.list
```

```{r}
atime.list[["measurements"]][N==323, .(expr.name, seconds=median, kilobytes)]
```

```{r}
plot(atime.list)

d <- ggplot(atime.list$measurements, aes(x = N, y = median, group = expr.name, colour = expr.name)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = min, ymax = max, fill = expr.name), alpha = 0.5, colour = NA) +
  scale_x_log10("N = number of rows in the dataset", limits = c(1, 1e3), breaks = 10^seq(1, 3)) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 25),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 15)
  )+
  scale_y_log10("Computational Time (Seconds)") +
  labs(x = "N = number of rows in the dataset", y = "Computational Time (Seconds)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

d <- d + geom_dl(aes(label = gsub(".replacement", "", expr.name)), method = list(dl.combine("last.points"), cex = 1.2))

ggsave("atime.list.png", plot = d, width = 10, height = 5, unit = "in", dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
(best.list <- atime::references_best(atime.list))
plot(best.list)


```

```{r}
# Generate the best list
best.list <- atime::references_best(atime.list)

# Set up the PNG device
png("best_list_plot.png", width=800, height=600)

# Plot with increased text sizes
plot(best.list, cex.lab=15, cex.axis=15, cex.main=18, cex.sub=18)

# Close the PNG device
dev.off()

```

```{r}
p <- ggplot(best.list$measurements, aes(x = N, y = median, group = expr.name, colour = expr.name)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = min, ymax = max, fill = expr.name), alpha = 0.5, colour = NA) +
  scale_x_log10("N = number of rows in the dataset", limits = c(1, 1e3), breaks = c(1, 10, 100, 1000)) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 25),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 15),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 15)
  ) +
  scale_y_log10("Computational Time (Seconds)") +
  labs(x = "N = number of rows in the dataset", y = "Computational Time (Seconds)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

p <- p + geom_dl(aes(label = gsub(".replacement", "", expr.name)), method = list(dl.combine("last.points"), cex = 1.2))

ggsave("best.list.png", plot = p, width = 10, height = 5, unit = "in", dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
pred.list <- predict(best.list, seconds=1e-2, kilobytes=10)
plot(pred.list)
```

```{r}
atime.list[["measurements"]][N==323, .(expr.name, seconds=median, kilobytes)]

pred.list[["prediction"]]

```
